_note: FL20 Prologue and South Cape (dirs prologue, south_cape; scenes $01-$08, $8C-$8F). Fragment contract of plan 3.1: `flags` holds the records of the flags this iteration owns (scratch rows keyed by scene, persistent single-area flags); `proposals` holds the 9 spine flags (FL31 writes their records). Evidence strings carry file:line plus the decimal ROM offset in braces. Scratch scopes use `actors` where one scene runs two unrelated handshake protocols with the same index; scene 6 index $02 and $04 carry two protocol meanings with the same scope (listed in `notes` with their gating flags) because the scope field has no phase.
